description:
ProcGenConfigs

About

A small mod that enables configuring aspects of the sectors generation through the ingame mod configs.
This mod requires LunaLib. It is incompatible with Adjusted Sector and Wide Horizons.

What can be modified?

- Amount of Stars per Sector, automaticly scaling the amount of generated content with it.
- The density of hyperspace nebula and storms in the sector.
- An optional config that decreases the amount of empty systems in the sector.

How to access these configurations?

In the main menu, click on the "Mod Settings" button in the top left.
Then click on "ProcGenConfigs" in the list. After making your changes, be sure to click on the save button.

Support

If you want to support my work, you can do so on Patreon.
You can also follow me there for free for blog posts and progress updates.
Any level of support is deeply appreciated!

discordPostHtml:
A mod for easily configuring a few simple Proc Gen Configurations.
This mod used to be part of Random-Assortment-of-Things, but has been split off for a variety of reasons.
If you are using RAT, make sure update it to the latest version before using this mod.

Download: https://github.com/Lukas22041/ProcGenConfigs/releases/latest/download/ProcGenConfigs.zip
